## Big Bell — G4 *Friendship is Magic*

**Who she is:** Appleloosa’s muscular **Pegasus buckball defender**, the lavender mare facing Fluttershy and Pinkie Pie alongside Braeburn in **“Buckball Season”** (S6E18). She returns in a buckball scene in **“The End in Friend”** (S8E17). Her physique resembles Bulk Biceps’s, but she is a separate character.

**Spot her:** Lavender-purple coat, very pale icy-blue-and-white mane, magenta eyes, chunky shoulders, small wings, and a **kettlebell cutie mark with a red heart**. She wears a red-and-yellow sports jersey during the match.

**Name:** *Big Bell* is **fan-chosen**, not verified as an official Hasbro name. On **February 4, 2017**, the r/listofponies identification poll adopted the suggestion “Big Bell”; other suggestions included “Kettlebell” and “Bella Heartweight.” No verified alternate identity or official production name.

**Voice:** No individually attributed dialogue or verified voice actor; she is a visually identified player rather than a named speaker in the S6E18 transcript.

**Show still:** [![Big Bell, close-up from Buckball Season](https://derpicdn.net/img/2016/9/7/1244097/large.png)](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/1030012/story-notes-the-final-game-of-the-season)  
*Animation: Hasbro/DHX; frame reproduced in a 2023 blog post by Admiral Biscuit (poster, not the animator). Original image uploader/artist attribution unverified.*
